newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end weak near lows, Unilever suffers.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end weak near lows, Unilever suffers.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Dutch shares unable to sustain brief late recovery and wilt into close to end near session lows as Wall Street heads south. Dealers say market tired out after recent run of good news on both corporate and economic fronts and technicals showing room for further pullback. Unilever falls again, ABN AMRO and Akzo Nobel both continue to suffer after recent results. KLM bucks trend after reports it near settlement with partner Northwest, Hoogovens up after confirms Belgian steel takeover.
*AEX closes down 9.69 points, 1.30 percent, at 737.46. Midcap AMX down 21.06, 1.88 percent, at 1100.53.
